# `to_variant_object`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
to_variant_object(expr)
```

Convert a nested input (array/map/struct) into a variant where maps and structs are converted to variant objects which are unordered unlike SQL structs. Input maps can only have string keys.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_variant_object, example 1
> SELECT to_variant_object(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2));
{"a":1,"b":2}
```

```sql
-- to_variant_object, example 2
> SELECT to_variant_object(array(1, 2, 3));
[1,2,3]
```

```sql
-- to_variant_object, example 3
> SELECT to_variant_object(array(named_struct('a', 1)));
[{"a":1}]
```

```sql
-- to_variant_object, example 4
> SELECT to_variant_object(array(map("a", 2)));
[{"a":2}]
```
